newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM aluminium recovers to end firmer, dlr helps.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM aluminium recovers to end firmer, dlr helps.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo aluminium futures recouped earlier losses to end mostly firmer after moving in tandem with the dollar, traders said on Wednesday.
"It's difficult to sell (TOCOM aluminium contracts). But it remains uncertain how far the metal can go from here on the LME) after recovering the key $,1600 level," said one trader.
"Nobody is willing to push them either way."

Benchmark June added 0.2 yen to close at 191.3 yen per kg after hitting the day's low of 189.8 yen. The April gained 0.4 yen to stand at 192.8, while others ranged from 0.3 yen weaker to 0.5 yen firmer.
The dollar was trading at around 114.50 yen late in Tokyo after wide swings on an announcement by Thailand that the Thai baht will be floated.

At 0710 GMT, the benchmark three-month aluminium on the London Metal Exchange (LME) was quoted $1,612/15. It scored a gain of $5 to $1,603 in London on Tuesday, while zinc charged higher to yet another 6-3/4year high.
